summary: {clerk} checks that a rebuilt hearing aid is identified where the shopper can see it through the wrapper.
realLife: FDA declined to prohibit consumer resale and required disclosure on the outer packaging and adequate reprocessing of used or rebuilt devices before resale.
inGame: needs: resale condition and packaging inspection.

turns.pulledBy: The sticker can be read through the wrapper.
turns.what: The customer points out the rebuilt designation.
turns.writesBack: The clerk shows the buyer the condition before the sale.

turns.pulledBy: The wrapper hides the condition notice.
turns.what: The clerk inspects a sealed carton after a complaint.
turns.writesBack: The clerk sets the box aside until its condition is visible.
